author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Long-time Magic artist Mark Poole talks about finally getting to enter the world of Middle-earth with Magic: the Gathering The Hobbit!  We also chat about growing up with Tolkien's books and the special place the world holds for him.

#mtgxthehobbit #magicthegathering #thehobbit
title: MTG Artist Mark Poole Talks Rivendell & Bilbo for The Hobbit
